Marshall & Dominguez LLP
Pearland, TX
Phone 281-555-1704
Settlement Demand
November 24, 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1417 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our office represents Corey Petty in connectoin with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on June 27, 2024. Our
client was lawfully making a left turn when your insured failed to yield the right of way and struck the driver's side of
our client's vehicle. The police report documents the other driver's admission at the scene that he did not see our
client's car before impact.
As a result of the collision, our client suffered a serious knee injury. Following the crash, our client was transported for
emergency evaluation and has since undergone a course of physical therapy, with ongoing treatment recommended
by the treating orthopedic physician. Our client has been unable to work full duty and has incurred substantial medical
bills, along with lost wages and out-of-pocket expenses related to transportation and care.
Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured violated the duty to yield on a left-turn-across-traffic situation, and no
reasonable fact finder is likely to assign our client any meaningful share of fault. Our client has been fully cooperative
throughout the claims process and has provided all requested records.
To resolve this matter without litigation, we demand payment of $89,000.00, inclusive of all damages described
above. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory
response within that period, we will file suit without further notice.
Expert review: Janet Williams, neurologist
Sincerely,
Nina Stewart
Marshall & Dominguez LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
